verdict.rationale: JIT funding is clearly documented — the merchant's own system approves/denies funding requests per authorization (marqeta-docs-4) — but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a prefunded-balance funding option or any comparison of cash-flow tradeoffs between the two models. Missing for 10: explicit prefunded balance funding docs, side-by-side cash-flow tradeoff guidance, finance-lead-oriented configuration guidance for choosing between models.
